messages:
Anya: Heads-up — perf regression after today's deploy to prod. Small-batch chat tail latency +35% on canary nodes. Flamegraphs in the link. Observed a spike in kernel compilations and many KV cache invalidations. Rolling hold on rollout. /cc @Tomas @Maureen

Raj: Is this the canary rollout or full? link?

Anya: Canary only (10% traffic). Dashboard: https://perf.redwood/board/xyz. Repro locally with `./run_client --profile --batch=4 --seq=64`.

runtime-qa-bot: Uploaded flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/fg/1812349999.svg

Maureen: Quick grep of compile logs shows repeated compiles for `quant_kern_v3` and fallback to `float_kern_legacy`. Snippet:

```
[compile] kernel=quant_kern_v3 target=a100 node=serve-03 time=0.78s
[kv-cache] invalidation key=prefix-123 reason=autotune-change
[compile] kernel=float_kern_legacy target=a100 node=serve-03 time=0.62s
```

Maureen: Started `git bisect` locally, suspecting autotune scoring change in recent heuristic PR.

Raj: Which PR? We should bisect on canary images and revert if needed.

Maureen: Bisect result points at PR #4523 by @tomas: `pref-kernel-priority` — changes the autotune score multiplier from `1.0` to `0.85` for float kernels which unintentionally favors quant kernels on short sequences.

Tomas: Yup that was the change. It was to reduce float kernel churn for long seqs but I missed the short-seq side effect. I'll open a revert PR now.

Anya: Until revert lands — please pause rollout and pin canary to previous image. @devops-bot pause-rollout 4523

devops-bot: Deployment `canary/served-model-61` paused by Anya. Reason: perf regression, compile storm. :no_entry:

ci-bot: Perf CI shows regression at 2026-03-17T18:02Z — job `perf/small-batch` +28% median latency. https://ci.redwood/job/1234

Maureen: Repro steps for QA:

```
# reproduce
docker run -e MODEL=redwood/llama:prod-canary \
  perf/client:latest ./run_client --profile --batch=4 --seq=64 --iter=500
```

Maureen: Also attach a short flamegraph and `perf top` dump for review.

Tomas: I'll send PR #4589 to revert the autotune multiplier and add a unit test to ensure short-seq preference doesn't flip.

Raj: After revert, we should run a 1h canary and then proceed. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 

Anya: Filing a rollout blocker ticket and tagging eng-runtime. Ticket: https://issues.redwood/12288 — block until PR 4589 merged and perf validated.

runtime-qa-bot: Note: KV cache invalidations during this window caused a spike in cold-start token cost. See metrics: https://metrics.redwood/kv/invalidation?from=2026-03-17T17:50Z&to=2026-03-17T19:00Z

Maureen: I'll coordinate validation and close the blocker once we have 1h stable canary.
